crossRefs.note: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, ‘This is how you shall bless the children of Israel.’ You shall tell them,
Many say, “Who will show us any good?” Yahweh, let the light of your face shine on us.
May God be merciful to us, bless us, and cause his face to shine on us.
Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.
Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
Turn us again, God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
Turn us again, Yahweh God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
Make your face shine on your servant. Teach me your statutes.
The city has no need for the sun or moon to shine, for the very glory of God illuminated it, and its lamp is the Lamb.
For the mountain of Zion, which is desolate. The foxes walk on it.
Lord, hear. Lord, forgive. Lord, listen and do. Don’t defer, for your own sake, my God, because your city and your…
Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.
For however many are the promises of God, in him is the “Yes.” Therefore also through him is the “Amen”, to the glory…

translations.web: “Now therefore, our God, listen to the prayer of your servant, and to his petitions, and cause your face to shine on your sanctuary that is desolate, for the Lord’s sake.
translations.bsb: So now, our God, hear the prayers and petitions of Your servant. For Your sake, O Lord, cause Your face to shine upon Your desolate sanctuary.

translations.asv: Now therefore, O our God, hearken unto the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplications, and cause thy face to shine upon thy sanctuary that is desolate, for the Lord's sake.
